summary.intent: Resolve automated PR review comments from Copilot and CodeRabbit on PR #392, then fix a release gate gap where test: commits could merge to main without blocking release-please PRs from merging before E2E passed.
summary.outcome: All 3 review comments on PR #392 were fixed and resolved. PR #394 was created consolidating E2E change detection into a single ci-e2e.yml orchestrator and adding a retrigger mechanism so the release gate re-evaluates after E2E completes on main. Multiple rounds of automated review comments on PR #394 were also resolved.

repo: Release gate (release-gate.yml) only enforced E2E for release-please-- branches; non-release PRs auto-passed with 'Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable', making it a meaningless gate for feature PRs
E2E ran on push to main but the release-please PR had already received stale green checks — test: commits don't trigger release-please to update the PR, so the gate never re-ran
desktop-e2e.yml already used dorny/paths-filter pattern with conditional job skipping; e2e.yml did not have this optimization
apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.lock does not exist — root Cargo.lock is the only lockfile for the desktop Rust workspace
Committed fixture files live in tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/ and include test-audio.mp3, test-document.pdf, test-video-small.mp4, test-video.mp4
The project uses a COMMITTED_FIXTURES guard pattern to prevent test utility functions from overwriting or deleting committed fixture files during cleanup
planning docs live in .planning/phases/ with numbered phase directories (e.g. 34-e2e-test-expansion-staging-baselines)
gh run rerun preserves original GITHUB_SHA so re-triggered runs use a stale checkout — desktop change detection must diff against origin/main instead of HEAD

code.finding: createTestMediaFile, createTestImageFile, createTestTextFile, and createTestBinaryFile all needed a COMMITTED_FIXTURES guard to prevent overwriting/deleting committed fixture files during test cleanup
Was missing faro_enabled: true metadata field required by the schema
page.evaluate() in teardown needed a page.isClosed() guard to prevent errors when the page was already closed
jq // empty pattern causes parse error on empty string; must use // null or select(.) instead. Also log messages incorrectly said 'Web E2E' when polling ci-e2e.yml
dorny/paths-filter requires fetch-depth: 0 to access the before SHA for accurate diff; fetch-depth: 1 (default) is insufficient

workflow: CodeRabbit has per-PR quota limits that cause rate limiting (~23 min cooldown observed); Copilot reviews arrive faster (~10 min)
gh api GraphQL reviewThreads only returns inline review threads; PR-level review summary comments (outside diff range) are not returned and must be fetched via gh api /pulls/{pr}/reviews
gh api REST replies require --field in_reply_to=INT (not -f) for integer fields; using -f treats the value as a string and fails
When using workflow_call for reusable workflows, vars context is automatically inherited from the calling repository — no special configuration needed
Consolidating change detection into a single orchestrator workflow avoids duplicating dorny/paths-filter across multiple workflow files
Background polling with sleep loops accumulated many stale task notifications that completed after the main work was done; a more targeted polling approach would be cleaner

friction: CodeRabbit rate limiting caused ~23 minute wait before the second review arrived, requiring extensive polling loops
Background polling tasks proliferated (20+ tasks) making it difficult to track which polls were still relevant
gh api REST reply commands hit network timeouts requiring retries
Outside-diff-range PR review comments are invisible to the GraphQL reviewThreads query, requiring manual URL lookup to find them
First attempt to fix the release gate addressed the wrong problem (adding E2E to feature PRs) before understanding the actual issue was stale checks on release-please PRs
Multiple rounds of review comments on PR #394 required several fix-commit-push-resolve cycles
open_items: PR #394 still needs to be merged — the consolidated ci-e2e.yml orchestrator and retrigger-release-gate fix are pending

The release gate desktop patterns in release-gate.yml may still be out of sync with ci-e2e.yml patterns (CodeRabbit flagged this in an outside-diff-range comment near end of transcript, fix was committed but transcript ends before confirmation)
